about: The source model of a netCDF3 file (spec/zarrify/netcdf3.md §6.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/netcdf3.md#63-the-ir-mirror>): the elements a parser emits, and the bounds of what it reads (§7.4 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/netcdf3.md#74-checks>). The checks are the reader's (`netcdf3/mod.rs`), in the profile's order; projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

elements.about: The IR of a netCDF3 file: its header, the data of each fixed-size variable, and the records. Bytes no element claims are gaps.

header.about: the header, from byte 0 to the end of its variable list

variables/<k>.about: the values of the fixed-size variable at position k of the header, whose form is {recipe: [[src, 0, null]]}

records.about: the records, from the least begin of a record variable to the end of the last record or the file's end, whichever is first
